requirements.title: Extract atomic capabilities, not vendor verdicts
requirements.objective: Each capability must be recorded individually with status, evidence and a taxonomy recommendation
requirements.description: Avoids the failure mode of recording that a project is good rather than what it does.

evidence: Every record has a unique CAP id, an evidence array and a recommendation from the fixed taxonomy
Recommendations are restricted to the seven permitted values
A capability with no evidence cannot be recorded as IMPLEMENTED
